rows.reporting: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development
rows.title: KR Water Framework - Nookat Water sub-project
rows.description: The Project will finance critical drinking water supply improvements in Nookat,  including rehabilitating water systems, household metering and O&M equipment  procurement. The Project fully complies with the Bank's Country Strategy for  the Kyrgyz Republic (BDS/KY/19-01F) and corresponds to the current MEI Sector  Strategy (BDS19-069(F)). Moreover, the Project fully aligns with the Green  Economy Transition (GET) Approach BDS15-196(F)), promoting climate change  adaptation and ensuring availability and sustainable management of water and  sanitation, as well as the Strategy for the Promotion of Gender Equality  2016-2020 (BDS15-264/(F)). It positively contributes to SDG 6 and SDG 5.  Mobilised amount is EUR 2 million.
